meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 当你问起界面里的任何 Tip 提示时，Claude 会先查实时提示列表、核对你这台设备实际能看到的提示，再读取对应功能源码，用你的语言给出带具体机制和文件路径的深度解释，而不是泛泛复述提示文字。
howto.when: 当你提到某条 Tip: 行、说出“give-me-tips”，或询问某个提示的含义或功能运作方式时触发。

say.text: 刚才那条 Tip: 具体是什么意思？
say.note: Claude 会先查实时提示列表并解释这条 tip。

say.text: 给我详细讲讲这条 Tip 背后的实现机制
say.note: 它会先读源码验证，再给出具体原理。

say.text: 我目前能看到哪些提示？为什么？
say.note: 它会检查你的设置和可见性条件后回答。

howto.what_en: When you ask about any Tip: line, Claude first queries the live tip list, checks which tips are actually visible to you, then reads the feature code before explaining the concrete mechanism with file paths, in your language.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention a Tip: line, say 'give-me-tips', or ask what a tip means or how a tipped feature works.

say_en.text: What does that Tip: line mean exactly?
say_en.note: Claude queries the live tip list and explains it.

say_en.text: Explain the mechanism behind this tip in depth.
say_en.note: It verifies against the code first.

say_en.text: Which tips can I see right now, and why?
say_en.note: It checks your settings and visibility gates.
